```
vim -u DEFAULTS 8.1.1186 not crash
```
- Operating system/version:  archlinux 64bit
- Terminal name/version:konsole
- `$TERM`: TERM=xterm-256color


### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

edit a rust source, typing 

```rust
for i in 100..vector.len()-1 {}
```
and press esc to exit edit mode, then press i to let cursor between '{' and '}' ,and press enter to create new line, neovim 100% crash (but only happens if I edit particular rs file), even run with -u NORC. with some try, I've found that it crash only if have (tried) to do auto-completion.  I'm using debug version neovim so auto-completion introduces a delay during typing. if no such delay happend, neovim not crash (not 100% confirmed)
